title: Japanese-Style Lazy Popcorn Feast
description: A unique twist on the classic snack, this Japanese-inspired lazy popcorn feast combines flavors and textures for a delightful treat.

ingredients.name: Lazy sauce (see notes)
ingredients.notes: Lazy sauce is a mixture of soy sauce, sake, mirin, and sugar. If not available, substitute with a mixture of equal parts soy sauce and sake.

instructions: Pop the popcorn kernels in a pot or a popcorn maker.
In a small saucepan, heat the sesame oil over medium heat. Add the grated daikon and cook until it's slightly caramelized.
In a separate bowl, mix together the lazy sauce and chopped scallions.
Once the popcorn is popped, drizzle the lazy sauce mixture over the popcorn and toss to coat.
Sprinkle the sesame seeds over the popcorn and toss again to combine.
Transfer the popcorn to a serving bowl and top with the caramelized daikon.
